title: Cloud Security: outage claim window
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for outage claim window.

## Basis

Outage claim filing term in calendar days: Inclusive outage-claim filing period after the incident closes; calendar days integer.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Outage claim filing term in calendar days |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 30 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 30 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 30 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 30 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 30 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 30 |

## Tier comparison

The listed outage claim window bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
